senses.gloss:
भृ (ञ्) भृञ् r. 1st cl. (भरति-ते) (डु, ञ्) डुभृञ् r. 3rd cl. (विभर्त्ति विभृते)
1. To nourish, to cherish, to foster, to maintain.
 2. To fill.
 3. To
hold or support.
 4. To suffer.
 5. To confer. With सम्, 1. To col-
lect.
 2. To prepare.
 3. To nourish.
 4. To produce.

भृ (भ्र) मि m. (-मिः)
 1. A whirlwind, a hurricane, a high wind.
 2. An
eddy, a whirlpool.
 E. भ्रम् to turn round, इन् Unādi aff., and the
semi-vowel changed to its congener.

भॄ r. 9th. cl. (भॄणाति)
 1. To blame or censure.
 2. To nourish, to
maintain, to support.
 3. To hold.
 4. To fry.
